title: Log the long words
description: Print every word that has at least min_len characters, each on its own line as `LONG: ` followed by the word (one space after the colon), in the original order. Shorter words are skipped without any output. Return how many lines were printed. min_len may be zero or negative, in which case every word counts as long.
notes: Level 1. Filter then print. Boundary: length equal to min_len is long. Spaces count as characters. Empty word with min_len <= 0 prints 'LONG: ' with a trailing space.
